items.description: Review Android, desktop, and shared changes for parity; either carry behavior across platforms or record why a platform-specific difference is intentional.
items.evidence: RF calibration profile, parsing, state preservation, formatting, and firmware-offer keys are shared and tested for Android and desktop. Each UI reuses those shared abstractions. Resident-cache directory access stays in platform UI integration, while cache selection is shared JVM code. Desktop focus and stale-dialog handling remain desktop-only because they address Swing window behavior. Changed-source comment audit found appropriate comments for oscillator-specific calibration, echoed replies, resident cache protection, focus, and modal-dialog lifecycle; no missing or redundant comments found.
